name: ruflo-graph-intelligence
description: RuFlo Graph Intelligence Engine — real-time relationship intelligence with complexity-aware execution. Single-entry personalized PageRank, streaming delta updates, witness-signed reasoning artifacts, federation-distributable PR vectors. Declares the zero-dependency @ruvnet/sublinear-core as its solver; ships a sublinear-core skill for PPR, local push and sparse solves.

guard.title: Write guard
guard.description: Refuse writes and commands on this plugin's own tools that hold a key, token or password.
